name: Inumaru Sensei no Hokenshitsu Jisshuu
original_name: 犬丸先生の保健室実習
source:
The protagonist is Inumaru-sensei, a student teacher in the school infirmary! 
Whether you strike up a conversation or get a little hands-on with Rikuto-kun—a troubled boy who visits the infirmary—
let’s just do all sorts of things with him!
translation:
主角是学校医务室的见习老师犬丸老师！
无论是与陆斗君——一个去医务室探访的问题男孩——进行交谈还是亲自动手——
让我们和他一起做各种各样的事情吧！
